heroHeadline: Pakistan–Taliban Border Clashes Spread to Paktika, Waziristan and Torkham
heroSubtitle: Forces exchanged fire in Paktika and South Waziristan on October 27, with Pakistan reporting one civilian killed, and intermittent fighting was reported at Torkham on October 28. Each side blames the other for starting it and casualty claims are unverified.
